subject: Roadmap inventory map and questionnaire prioritization
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@nimbusbank.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial questionnaire intake + high-level scope questions

Ben / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Nimbus is ramping our third‑party assessment and we want to align the questionnaire work (SIG + CAIQ + SOC 2 evidence requests) with your ISO 27001 / FedRAMP roadmap so we don’t duplicate asks for our auditors. A few clarifying items up front: 

1) Are you maintaining a single control-to-questionnaire crosswalk (ISO→SIG/CAIQ/FedRAMP) that we can reference, or will you provide per-question artifacts?
2) For FedRAMP scoping, do you have a published list of environments in-scope (staging vs prod) and data residency boundaries?
3) What is your proposed cadence for delivering sample artifacts? Our auditor prefers weekly batches and a dry run two weeks before evidence cutover.

We’ll share our SIG intake doc and the specific questions we consider blockers for our internal approval. Can you confirm point persons for KMS, logging, and incident response?

Appreciate it — Laura

--
Laura Jensen
Senior Vendor Risk Manager | Nimbus Bank
laura.jensen@nimbusbank.com
+1 415 555 0198
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@nimbusbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial questionnaire intake + high-level scope questions

Laura —

Thanks, and great chatting. Short answers up front: we maintain a single canonical crosswalk that maps our ISO 27001 controls to SIG/CAIQ and FedRAMP control families; we also publish per-request artifacts when auditors need originals. Staging is considered out of scope for FedRAMP by default, prod is in-scope, and we have regioned deployments in us-west and eu-central. I’ve attached a first-draft mapping (redwood_map_draft.xlsx) that shows the approach.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- Week 0 (this week): Share intake and identify blocker questions (Laura)
- Week 1: Redwood to assign owners and supply control narratives + mapping sheet (Ben/Kim)
- Week 2: Sample artifact batch 1 (logs, KMS policy, key rotation proof)
- Week 3: SIG/CAIQ responses draft for review
- Week 4: Audit dry run / sample extraction rehearsal

Owners I’m assigning now: 
- KMS/HSM evidence & key rotation: kimberly_park@redwood.com
- Logging and snapshot retention: olga_petrov@redwood.com
- Control narratives and ISO mapping: ben_carter@redwood.com

Can you confirm the auditor’s weekly batch window (Mon/Tue preferred) and whether you need attestations signed by our legal team?

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Sales (Strategic Accounts) | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@nimbusbank.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial questionnaire intake + high-level scope questions

Laura / Ben —

Quick technical notes to avoid back-and-forth when you see the SIG/CAIQ asks: 
- KMS: we use customer‑segregated keys in HSM for private deployment customers; for hosted accounts, we manage keys in a FedRAMP-ready KMS and can provide key rotation records (monthly) and HSM attestation where applicable. I’ve attached a short index of what artifacts we can deliver quickly (kms_evidence_index.pdf).
- Logging: aggregated control-plane logs are retained 90 days by default; production snapshot exports for customers in scope can be staged for a 1-year retention extract if required by the auditor.
- Access reviews: quarterly role review artifacts are available as CSV exports; we’ll need to redact a handful of internal-only IDs.

If Nimbus needs the HSM attestation, flag it now so we can engage the ops team (lead time ~10 business days).

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Security & GRC Program Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@nimbusbank.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap inventory map and questionnaire prioritization

Laura —

We can support the dry run the week of Dec 6th. Operational asks for us: 
- A short list (≤10) of high-priority SIG/CAIQ questions you want validated during the dry run.
- Target log slices (time ranges + service names) and at least one example customer id to use for sample extraction.
- A secure upload location for artifacts (we prefer a temporary signed S3 URL; if Nimbus must provide, we can accept DocuSign/portal link).

On the FedRAMP side, please confirm whether Nimbus requires the moderate or high baselines mapped. We’re currently mapping for moderate but can surface gaps for high if you indicate that path.

I’ll coordinate the ops team for sample extraction once we have the list.

Olga
